description:
Learn what GitHub Copilot Fusion is and how it removes the guesswork of choosing between models from the leading providers. Select Standard, High, or Max effort levels, and Copilot Fusion automatically determines whether to route your prompt to a single model or combine multiple models, balancing quality, speed, and cost for every task. Watch a live walkthrough of multi-model orchestration in action, from everyday UI tweaks to multi-pass feature builds. 

Try Copilot Fusion in your editor today and explore the documentation at https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/models/copilot-fusion

description:
Marks & Spencer (M&S) is a leading UK retailer with more than 1,000 stores across 70 global markets. As the business scales its food, fashion, and beauty operations, engineering teams rely on GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows to accelerate software delivery across the entire development lifecycle. By automating ticket scaffolding, code generation, and pull request reviews with specialized AI agents, engineers have achieved productivity uplifts of up to 75% for key tasks. Discover how M&S modernises retail engineering while keeping developers firmly in control of architectural decisions.
